# Pi Agent Orchestrator

> Multi-agent orchestration extension for the Pi coding-agent host, including sub-agents, structured handoffs, swarms, scheduling, prompt compression, and a responsive TUI.

## Primary documentation (installed package)

After `pi install npm:@groeponline/pi-agent-orchestrator`, read raw markdown from the package root (e.g. `node_modules/@groeponline/pi-agent-orchestrator/`):

- `README.md` — overview and installation
- `docs/architecture.md` — system topology and permission model
- `docs/api-reference.md` — settings schema, tools, hooks, CLI
- `docs/custom-agents.md` — agent frontmatter and handoff protocol
- `AGENTS.md` — repository invariants for coding agents
- `llms-full.txt` — expanded machine-readable context (this file's sibling)
